title: Odor Recheck Terms by Fire & Smoke Mitigation Tier
content:
After cleaning on a Fire & Smoke Mitigation job is complete, a smoke odor can return. These terms state, for each tier, whether a recheck visit is included, the window within which a returning odor is rechecked and re-treated at no charge, and the per-visit fee for rechecks outside that inclusion.

## Terms

- Included recheck: Whether one odor recheck visit after cleaning complete is included without charge, boolean.
- Recheck window: Calendar days after cleaning complete within which a returning odor is rechecked and re-treated at no charge, count.
- Recheck fee: Odor recheck and re-treatment visit beyond the included recheck or after the recheck window, per visit, USD.

## Table of terms

| Tier | Included recheck | Recheck window (calendar days after cleaning complete) | Recheck fee per visit (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Smoke Odor Response | Yes | 14 | 125.00 |
| Light Smoke and Soot Cleanup | Yes | 14 | 125.00 |
| Moderate Fire and Smoke Cleanup | Yes | 30 | 145.00 |
| Heavy Fire Cleanup | Yes | 30 | 165.00 |
| Structural Fire Large Loss | Yes | 30 | 195.00 |
| Commercial Fire Large Loss | Yes | 30 | 225.00 |

## Notes to the terms

- Every tier includes one recheck. The window is 14 calendar days on the two lighter tiers and 30 calendar days on the other four.
- The fee applies to a visit beyond the included recheck, or to a visit after the recheck window, at the figure on the job's own row: from 125.00 on the lighter tiers up to 225.00 on Commercial Fire Large Loss.

## Illustration (hypothetical visits)

On a hypothetical Heavy Fire Cleanup job, a second recheck visit, being beyond the included recheck, is a visit at that row's fee of 165.00; on a hypothetical Smoke Odor Response job, a recheck visit after its 14-day window is a visit at 125.00.
